description: Native Linux runtime for SlimLO DOCX-to-PDF converter. Contains a minimal, LTO-optimized LibreOffice headless engine (libmergedlo.so), the SlimLO C API (libslimlo.so), and the slimlo_worker process for x64 and arm64. Built from vanilla LibreOffice source with 30 idempotent patch scripts that strip the engine to its Writer + UNO + PDF export path. Requires system libraries: libfontconfig1, libfreetype6, libcairo2, libxml2, libxslt1.1, libicu, libnss3.
